sources.name: MathArena ArXivMath (08/2026 round)
sources.metric: % accuracy on the August 2026 ArXivMath questions
sources.notes: Fresh fetch 2026-09-29 of latest August ArXivMath round. All 11 published rows across 9 exact-roster models preserved, including Astra max/low and Fable high/low. Every model detail page was fetched for exact reasoning_effort, thinking type, harness and version; labels alone omit Muse max, Kimi max, Gemini high. Kimi max comes from explicit config, not from its Think name. September 24 homepage announcement gives board update date. MathArena Qwen3.8-Max is August 2 checkpoint, not roster September 2 checkpoint; omitted. Fable max model page has May/June results but no August run. No Sonnet 5.5 results. Most selected variants carry released-after-competition warnings (all except Kimi); this is chronology, not demonstrated training contamination. Provider routing allow_fallbacks:false does not prove absence of an older-checkpoint harness fallback, so fallback remains null. Legacy summary fields must not select an effort for effort-aware analysis. Do not count overall or older monthly rounds again.
